sentences.text:
Coram:
 Hon'Ble Dr. Justice Sudhir Kumar Jain
 Order

The present petition is filed under section 482 Cr.P.C. read with Article 227 of the Constitution for quashing of FIR bearing no. 0324/2023 dated 23.08.2023 registered under sections 376/506 IPC at P.S. Vivek Vihar.
2. The counsel for the petitioner seeks permission to withdraw the present petition.
3. The present petition along with pending application, stands dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to the petitioner to file fresh petition in case of altered circumstances.
DR. SUDHIR KUMAR JAIN, J DECEMBER 18, 2023 N
